notes: Taḥwīl «ح» after «حدثنا خالد»: the second branch's «عن خالد الحذاء» is the continuation both branches share (rule 3), so it is the shared tail
«خالد يعني الطحان», «- يعني ابن عبد الله -» and «- المعنى -» are editor glosses, left out (rule 1); the surfaces are «خالد» and «مطرف»
The Prophet is not written; «عياض بن حمار» is the Companion whose report the saying is
